clue.text: The text made the advertising in a man count

parts.note: PR, public relations, is the business of publicity and promotion
Ted is a man's name, short for Edward
to count is to be important, to matter

explanation.surface: Some advertising copy was written so that a single man would count.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' is a link word joining the definition to the wordplay; 'in' is used as it stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Printed matter is any material produced by a press, such as books or leaflets: written words on paper.

clue.text: In giving ammunition to a person he delivers the goods

parts.note: rounds are cartridges or shells, units of ammunition
a man is a person

explanation.surface: Someone supplies ammunition to a fighter as part of a supply run.
explanation.definitionFit: A roundsman is a tradesman who makes regular delivery calls, like a milkman or baker's boy on his route.

clue.text: Requires a river to be rising in two directions

indicators.note: the river's letters sit inside the pair of compass points

parts.note: N and S, north and south, are two compass directions

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland, and another on the English-Welsh border

explanation.surface: A river that swells upwards needs to flow two ways at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Needs and requires are synonyms: both mean must have.

clue.text: Necessarily consequent on being like Longbourn

explanation.surface: Something follows inevitably from resembling a certain house.
explanation.walkthrough: Longbourn, the Bennet family home in Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice, is bound by an entail that passes it to Mr Collins, the nearest male heir.
explanation.definitionFit: Entailed means involved as a necessary result; an entailed estate is one whose inheritance is restricted to a fixed line of heirs.

clue.text: Sign of distress at the beginning of a month

definitions.text: at the beginning of a month

explanation.surface: Trouble is signalled as a new month starts.
explanation.walkthrough: The radio call for help comes from French m'aidez, 'help me'.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayday is the international radio distress call; May Day is the first day of May, the start of that month.

clue.text: He hold a belief concerning death although the right car is produced in the examination

definitions.text: He hold a belief concerning death

indicators.note: the right and the car are placed inside the examination

parts.note: a test is an examination
the Mini is a small British car

explanation.surface: A believer in mortality sees the correct car turn up during his exam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' marks the insertion: the examination is split to hold the right car. The definition reads 'He hold', as printed in the paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminist, in theology, holds that God fixes a term or limit of grace before a person's death, after which repentance is impossible.

clue.text: Conclusion of poem recited in a golden voice

indicators.note: the answer lies inside the run of letters of these two words

explanation.surface: The final lines of a poem are spoken by a rich, mellow voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recited' is a link word suggesting the poem being read.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoi is a short closing stanza that ends some poems, such as a ballade.

clue.text: Material provided for girl's relative

parts.note: a mother is a relative
for can mean of, as in love for or love of something
Pearl is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Some fabric is supplied for a young woman's relation.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'girl's relative' as the relative of the girl Pearl.
explanation.definitionFit: Mother-of-pearl is nacre, the iridescent substance lining some shells, used to make buttons and inlays.

clue.text: Secretaries give dissipated strangers hope

indicators.note: dissipated means scattered or wasted, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Office assistants offer encouragement to dissolute outsiders.
explanation.definitionFit: Stenographers are shorthand typists, who take down dictation as secretaries do.

clue.text: The tune Polly played so richly

indicators.note: a tune played freely here means its letters are performed in a new order

explanation.surface: Polly performs the melody lavishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulently means in a wealthy, luxurious way, which is what richly means.

clue.text: Bolt in and arrive too soon

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters of these two words

explanation.surface: Someone dashes inside after turning up early.
explanation.definitionFit: A rivet is a metal pin, a kind of bolt, used to fasten plates together.

clue.text: The underworld is the place for headless ghosts

indicators.note: a headless word loses its first letter, here the S at the front

parts.note: shades are ghosts or spirits of the dead

explanation.surface: Hell is home to decapitated spectres.
explanation.definitionFit: Hades is the Greek realm of the dead, the classical underworld.

clue.text: Exhaustion in one nation which has fallen apart

indicators.note: a nation that has collapsed has its letters broken up and reassembled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Weariness pervades a single collapsed country.
explanation.definitionFit: Inanition is exhaustion or emptiness caused by lack of nourishment.

clue.text: Recall concerned with one who belongs

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as in business letters
a member is someone who belongs to a club or group

explanation.surface: Someone thinks back with a person who is part of the group.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall something is to bring it back to mind, which is what remembering is.

clue.text: Hot after a girl and a writer is distorted

indicators.note: hot comes after the girl, so its letter follows hers

parts.note: a miss is a girl or young unmarried woman
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: Passion pursuing a young woman and an author has become twisted.
explanation.definitionFit: Misshapen means deformed or out of shape, so twisted or distorted.

clue.text: Something to hold gear of a man who goes with an unattractive woman

parts.note: Kit is a man's name, short for Christopher
bag is an insulting slang word for an unattractive woman, as in old bag

explanation.surface: A man accompanies a plain woman, carrying his equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitbag is a long cylindrical canvas bag in which a soldier or traveller carries belongings.

clue.text: A little lake exists in the midst of a sea of projectiles

indicators.note: the lake and exists are placed in the middle of the sea

parts.note: the Baltic is a sea in northern Europe
L is the abbreviation for lake, as on maps
is means exists

explanation.surface: A small lake lies within a sea full of missiles.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballistic means relating to the flight of projectiles, such as shells or missiles.

clue.text: Something on the stage which makes a player fall down

parts.note: a back is a defensive player in football, rugby or hockey
to drop is to fall

explanation.surface: Some stage scenery causes an actor to collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'player' suggests an actor on the stage, but it is a team player.
explanation.definitionFit: A backdrop is a painted cloth hung at the back of a stage as scenery.

clue.text: Best if turning back home

indicators.note: the little word if is read backwards

parts.note: a nest is a home, especially a bird's

explanation.surface: It would be best to go back home.
explanation.definitionFit: Finest is the superlative of fine, so the very best.

clue.text: The veil provides mysterious power if there is no place for money

indicators.note: the place for money is set inside the power, the phrase marking what goes within

parts.note: mana is a supernatural force or authority, in Polynesian belief
a till is the cash drawer in a shop

explanation.surface: A veil gives magical strength when there is nowhere to keep cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'if there is' marks the insertion. The clue's 'no' has no job in the wordplay and reads as a link; it may be a misprint.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantilla is a lace or silk scarf worn over the head and shoulders, especially by Spanish women.

clue.text: The French holding a cry of pain to be disreputable

indicators.note: the French article holds the cry inside it

parts.note: le is French for the
ouch is an exclamation of pain

explanation.surface: French people suppress a yelp so as to seem dubious.
explanation.definitionFit: Louche means shady or of doubtful character, so disreputable.

clue.text: Protective system which makes a faulty heart operate

indicators.note: a faulty heart is out of order, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: to work is to operate or function

explanation.surface: A pacemaker makes a defective heart function.
explanation.definitionFit: An earthwork is a bank or mound of soil built as a fortification, a defensive structure.

clue.text: A male animal with a smell is an aggressive creature

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
BO, body odour, is an unpleasant smell

explanation.surface: A smelly male beast is a fierce one.
explanation.definitionFit: Rambo, the film hero, gave his name to any violently aggressive person.

clue.text: Common name for a worker

explanation.surface: A widespread surname belongs to a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Smith is the most common surname in Britain; a smith is a metalworker, such as a blacksmith.

clue.text: Time of magic

explanation.surface: A period of enchantment.
explanation.definitionFit: A spell is a period of time, as in a cold spell; it is also an incantation with magical power.

clue.text: Make fresh survey and cut down about a thousand

indicators.note: the cutting goes about, or around, the thousand

parts.note: to reap is to cut down crops
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Survey again and reduce the figure by around a thousand.
explanation.definitionFit: To remap is to chart an area again, making a new survey of it.

clue.text: President holds writer to be manual worker

indicators.note: the president holds the writer inside his name

parts.note: Jimmy Carter was the 39th US president
a pen is a writing instrument

explanation.surface: A president considers an author to be a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpenter is a craftsman who works with wood using hand tools.

clue.text: Strange men do couple with it for coppers

indicators.note: strange means odd, so these letters are put in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Odd men pair off with it in search of police officers.
explanation.definitionFit: The mounted police are police officers on horseback; coppers is slang for police.
